name: governance-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for governance-sdk and governance-sdk-platform. This package is not published — see packages/governance for the core SDK.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/plugins packages/adapters packages/governance && npm run build -w packages/governance-platform
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w packages/plugins && npm test -w packages/adapters && npm test -w packages/governance && npm test -w packages/governance-platform
scripts.lint: tsc -b --dry packages/core packages/plugins packages/adapters packages/governance >/dev/null && npm run lint -w packages/governance && npm run lint -w packages/governance-platform && node scripts/check-layering.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build -w packages/governance --silent && node packages/governance/dist/cli/init.js demo
